description: `--schedule daily` is not a job option; the suggested schedule spec runs daily.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown option.
Detail: unknown option --schedule for `cli job create`; cron expressions are not supported; a schedule job runs every interval_seconds seconds (3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily), set in the --spec-file JSON object
Action: Create a schedule job from a JSON spec on standard input, previewing it first: `printf '%s\\n' '{"interval_seconds":86400,"program_ref":"demo","type":"schedule"}' | prose cli job create --spec-file - --preview`.
